'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
****[[Shia]] [[Islamist]] [[militant]] group [[Hezbollah]] fires on five [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli]] outposts in the [[Shebaa Farms]] with guided missiles and [[mortar (weapon)|mortar]] shells. A Hezbollah member is killed during a subsequent [[shootout|gunbattle]] with Israeli troops. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hezbollah-says-it-attacked-five-israeli-outposts-disputed-shebaa-farms-area-2023-10-14/ (Reuters)] [https://www.barrons.com/news/lebanon-s-hezbollah-says-fighter-killed-by-israel-fire-5f4c060b (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
****Two [[civilian]]s are killed during shelling by [[Israel]]i forces in [[Shebaa]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/two-civilians-killed-in-israel-shelling-of-lebanon-mayor-d8985f85 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
***[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****[[2023 attacks on Palestinians evacuating Gaza City]]
*****Seventy people have been killed in attacks on convoys [[emergency evacuation|evacuating]] [[Gaza City]], according to [[Hamas]]. [https://apnews.com/live/israel-hamas-war-live-updates#0000018b-2a3e-d2c3-a9ff-7a3e1cb80000 (AP)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/live-blog/israel-hamas-war-live-updates-rcna120252 (NBC News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/13/israel-hamas-live-dozens-killed-while-fleeing-to-southern-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
****At least 724 children are killed by Israeli shelling and [[airstrike]]s in Gaza, [[Defence for Children International]] says. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/10/14/middleeast/gaza-evacuation-deadline-israel-intl/index.html (CNN)]
****At least 27 Palestinians are killed by Israeli airstrikes in [[Jabaliya]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/13/israel-hamas-live-dozens-killed-while-fleeing-to-southern-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
****All living generations of 45 families have been wiped from the Gaza [[civil registry]], the health ministry says. [https://english.almayadeen.net/latestnews/2023/10/14/gazas-ministry-of-health:-45-families-in-gaza-have-been-wipe (Al Mayadeen)]
****The [[United Nations]] health organization has condemned Israel’s order to evacuate 22 hospitals treating more than 2,000 inpatients in northern Gaza, saying it "could be tantamount to a death sentence" [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/live-blog/israel-hamas-war-live-updates-gaza-hit-shelling-israel-defends-evacuat-rcna120419 (NBC News)]
****[[Medical Aid for Palestinians]] says ambulances in Gaza are being targeted by Israeli air raids. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/14/supplies-exhausted-doctors-exhausted-in-gaza-catastrophe-looms-large (Al Jazeera)]
****The Ahli Arab Hospital in Gaza is hit by Israeli strikes and sustained damage, says the [[Episcopal Diocese of Jerusalem]] that runs it. [https://www.anglicancommunion.org/communications/press-and-media/press-releases/anglican-communion-response-to-fresh-outbreak-of-violence-in-the-holy-land-and-al-ahli-arab-hospital-in-gaza-launches-emergency-appeal.aspx (Anglican Communion)]
****The [[UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs]] says that more than 50,000 [[pregnant]] women and newborn babies in Gaza do not have access to essential medical care. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231013-un-calls-for-294-mn-for-urgent-needs-in-gaza-occupied-west-bank (AFP via France 24)]
****The [[UNRWA|UN Palestine agency]] says that its shelters in Gaza are no longer safe and also warns that there is a shortage of water in Gaza. [https://www.tbsnews.net/worldbiz/middle-east/hamas-israel-war-dozens-killed-while-fleeing-gaza-homes-israel-conducts-ground (''The Business Standard'')]
***[[October-November 2023 Jenin incursion]]
****[[Israeli forces]] storm [[Jenin]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/israeli-army-raids-west-bank-city-of-jenin/3016523 (AA)]
***Palestine's [[United Nations]] envoy says that Palestinians are in danger of mass [[ethnic cleansing]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/palestinian-un-envoy-urges-un-chief-stop-israel-crime-against-humanity-2023-10-13/ (Reuters)]
***[[Amnesty International]] says that they have verified images of Israeli forces near [[Sderot]] using [[white phosphorus]]-based rounds. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/israel-hamas-war-white-phosphorous-gaza-palestinians-amnesty-hrw-reports/ (CBS News)]
***Al-Dura [[pediatric hospital]] is evacuated after being hit with [[white phosphorus munitions]] from Israeli airstrikes. [https://www.egypttoday.com/Article/1/127663/Israel-targets-children%E2%80%99s-hospital-in-Gaza-with-int%E2%80%99lly-prohibited-white (Egypt Today)]
***At least 15 hospitals are damaged by Israeli shelling and airstrikes, with two currently inoperable. 28 medical staff are killed and 23 ambulances are damaged or destroyed by Israeli airstrikes. [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/israel-hamas-war-gaza-strip/ (CBS News)]
***At least 2,268 Palestinians have been killed and 8,700 others injured in Israeli airstrikes on Gaza. At least 1,300 [[Israelis]] have been killed and at least 3,400 others are injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/longform/2023/10/9/israel-hamas-war-in-maps-and-charts-live-tracker (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] announce that airstrikes in the Gaza Strip have killed Murad Abu Murad, the head of Hamas's air operations and [[Ali Qadhi]], a top Hamas commander, both of whom were involved in the [[October 7 attacks|7 October invasion]] of Israel. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2023/10/14/israel-gaza-war-updates-hamas-palestine/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-768257 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Islamic terrorism in Europe]]
**[[Arras school stabbing]]
***[[France]] raises its [[Vigipirate]] to the highest level and announces the deployment of 7,000 [[French Armed Forces|soldiers]] through [[Opération Sentinelle]] following a fatal stabbing incident at a school in [[Arras]], [[Hauts-de-France]], which [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] describes as "[[Islamic terrorism|Islamist terror]]". [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/france-to-deploy-7000-soldiers-after-teachers-slaying (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**More than 5,000 demonstrators march in support of Palestine to the White House in  Washington, DC,. [https://www.tbsnews.net/hamas-israel-war/pro-palestinian-demonstrators-march-outside-white-house-718886 (AFP via The Business Standard)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Australian Indigenous Voice referendum]]
**A majority of voters in [[Australia]] vote to reject the establishment of an [[Indigenous Voice to Parliament]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/voting-begins-australia-landmark-indigenous-voice-referendum-2023-10-13/ (Reuters)] [https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/the-voice-referendum-live-updates-australians-head-to-polls-across-the-nation-to-vote-on-indigenous-constitutional-recognition-20231013-p5ec4w.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
*[[2023 New Zealand general election]]
**[[Prime Minister of New Zealand|Prime Minister]] [[Chris Hipkins]] concedes defeat to the [[New Zealand National Party]] which has won the most seats, although not a majority. [[Leader of the Opposition (New Zealand)|Opposition Leader]] [[Christopher Luxon]] is expected to form a [[coalition government]] with [[ACT New Zealand]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/voting-under-way-new-zealand-election-2023-10-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[UNITA]], [[Angola]]'s main [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] party, exits a special [[National Assembly (Angola)|parliamentary]] session in objection to the proposed public voting method for [[President of Angola|President]] [[João Lourenço]]'s [[impeachment]] motion, which is subsequently dismissed. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/10/16/world/americas-emea/angolas-opposition-walks-out-of-chaotic-impeachment-vote/1914825 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
